# Turing Mirror (图灵镜)

> Touching the setsuna, reaching the future.

Turing Mirror (Chinese: 图灵镜, Traditional: 圖靈鏡, Japanese: チューリングミラー) — official website. All products below are free. The site is available in Simplified Chinese (https://www.turingmirror.com/), Traditional Chinese, English (https://www.turingmirror.com/en/) and Japanese.

## Products

### RVC Fabric

RVC Fabric is a free, open-source Windows application developed by Turing Mirror. Change your voice and play music or sound effects in QQ, Discord and in-game voice chat, or mix your voice with backing tracks during a live stream. Its soundboard supports audio clips and hotkeys, alongside voice model management, vocal separation and model training.

- Platform: Windows desktop application
- Supports Windows 10 and Windows 11. Download the required runtime and models before first use.
- Page: https://www.turingmirror.com/en/products/rvc-fabric/ (简体中文: https://www.turingmirror.com/products/rvc-fabric/)
- Links: Download for Windows: https://cdn.turingmirror.com/d/rvc-fabric-setup; GitHub: https://github.com/Turing-Mirror/RVC-Fabric; Download from CNB: https://cnb.cool/Turing-Mirror/RVC-Fabric-Releases
- Official screenshot page: https://www.turingmirror.com/en/products/rvc-fabric/screenshots/

- Official screenshot: https://www.turingmirror.com/assets/products/rvc-fabric/home.png (RVC Fabric home screen with voice selection, audio tools and real-time conversion controls.)
- Official screenshot: https://www.turingmirror.com/assets/products/rvc-fabric/settings.png (RVC Fabric settings screen.)
- Official screenshot: https://www.turingmirror.com/assets/products/rvc-fabric/misc.png (RVC Fabric additional tools screen.)
- Real-time conversion: Converts microphone input to the selected voice, with original-voice bypass, ASIO channel selection and independent monitoring. Latency depends on hardware, the model and audio settings.
- Soundboard for voice chat and games: Play music, sound effects or selected clips into voice chat alongside your converted microphone audio, with overlapping playback, looping, separate volume control and global hotkeys.
- Audio effects: Includes a noise gate, compressor and 5-band parametric EQ, with presets and individual adjustments.
- Voices & presets: The voice library supports associated .index files and lets you save, import and export parameter presets.
- Community voice store: Download voice models from Turing Mirror and third-party sources, track progress and resume interrupted downloads.
- Audio toolbox: Provides vocal separation, text-to-speech and voice training tools. The training workflow covers audio slicing, pitch and feature extraction, model training and index export.
- Automatic acceleration: Supports NVIDIA CUDA and DirectML acceleration for AMD and Intel GPUs. Setup detects hardware and configures the corresponding runtime.

### MoeText / 喵言喵

Built on Android's accessibility service, MoeText rewrites what you type in QQ and Discord using rules you define: swap words, add sentence endings and kaomoji, and switch between styles like catgirl or classical Chinese in one tap.

- Platform: Android
- Requires Android 6.0 or later. Allow installation from unknown sources when prompted.
- Page: https://www.turingmirror.com/en/products/moetext/ (简体中文: https://www.turingmirror.com/products/moetext/)
- Links: Download APK: https://cdn.turingmirror.com/d/moetype; GitHub: https://github.com/Turing-Mirror/MoeText



- Style packs: Four built-in styles (catgirl, classical Chinese, emoji riddles and oracle) switch in one tap. Import and export your own as JSON.
- Text replacement rules: Combine quick swaps, custom replacements, sentence endings, fixed suffixes and random kaomoji.
- Two modes: Rewrite after a pause or as you type, and send messages the way you always do.
- Continuous editing: The suffix stays at the end of the sentence as you continue editing.
- Material 3 design: Follows system dark mode, with a live preview built in.
- Local processing: Chat text is processed on your device.

### Mirror-Test / 测试镜

Mirror-Test offers browser-based quizzes about anime, GalGames and girls’ bands.

- Platform: Web
- Nothing to install. Works in mobile and desktop browsers.
- Page: https://www.turingmirror.com/en/products/mirror-test/ (简体中文: https://www.turingmirror.com/products/mirror-test/)
- Links: Start a quiz: https://test.turingmirror.com/; GitHub: https://github.com/Turing-Mirror/Mirror-Test



- Summer 2026 anime personality test: Find the summer 2026 anime that matches you best.
- GalGame destined-route test: Which destined route would you end up on?
- Band-TI girls' band character test: 20 questions drawn from a pool of 100, covering 67 characters, 8 series and 14 bands.

### Turing Mirror UI / 图灵镜 UI / TRM UI

TRM UI provides consistent components, colors and interaction rules for Turing Mirror desktop apps. The gallery demonstrates the components and explains interaction, writing and motion. The component package connects to the project’s existing language and theme settings.

- Platform: Shared components for developers
- The gallery runs in a browser. Building the Tauri desktop application requires Rust.
- Page: https://www.turingmirror.com/en/products/trm-ui/ (简体中文: https://www.turingmirror.com/products/trm-ui/)
- Links: View project: https://github.com/Turing-Mirror/TRM-UI; Read integration guide: https://github.com/Turing-Mirror/TRM-UI/blob/5eaf13a5feb8d03002731b3b6874165aa03b9939/docs/components-v1.md



- Shared components: Buttons, forms, menus, tooltips and dialogs are maintained in one package. Products receive improvements by updating their dependency.
- Interactive design guidance: The gallery covers interaction, writing, typography, color and motion, and records replaced designs and the reasons for each change.
- Continuous interaction: Segmented controls support dragging. Filtered lists retain existing items, and panels resize continuously as content changes.
- Eight languages and theme settings: Common interface text is available in eight languages. Products can connect their translations and use shared color variables or their own theme.
